decisions.reason: Polymer concrete drain housings build directly on the firm's core drainage engineering know-how and complement its compatible product families, so it can interpret and improve them.
Floor-level shower drainage is the firm's central competence and strategic direction, and its rising visibility in 2019 signals successful assimilation.
As the designer flagship it rests on the firm's established drain technology and design focus, so a shift from its own page to a mention reflects routine portfolio rotation rather than failure.
The slope-integrated shower element extends the firm's waterproofing and installation knowledge toward low-profile accessible bathrooms, though it is somewhat further from its metal-fabrication core.
The backflow-protected basement drain was promoted on the home page and draws on the firm's proven drainage and patented safety features, so the firm can learn from it and develop it further.
